scope: Prospective evaluation of candidates AFTER v4; not a retrospective approval criterion for v4.

metric.primary: unmodified official spell_f1_mean, matching maximal H/A spells at tIoU .3/.4/.5/.6/.7; unknown-reference behavior unchanged
metric.aggregation: Compute per game first; development composite gives .25 each to original matched, original blind, SkillCorner natural, SkillCorner blind. Original stress is a separate guard. Do not pool frames or count augmented scenarios as independent games.

descriptive_bootstrap.unit: whole game, paired scenarios, stratified original/SkillCorner
descriptive_bootstrap.caveat: Descriptive interval; does not correct historical selection, source/opponent dependence or many experiments.

development.folds: Reuse exact frozen five-fold mapping. All augmentation/team-swap siblings and every fitted feature/normalizer/stack component exclude the complete scored fold.
development.provider_checks: Before freeze, repeat leave-one-provider-out diagnostics on a fixed training pool. Publish full train vs excluded-game scores by provider and all failures; no universal no-overfit assertion.
development.seeds: For stochastic candidates, predeclare 3 seeds (20261113/20261114/20261115), report each. Fix deployable single seed or ensemble before final test; never select the best seed using final-test scores.

reserve.source: OpenSportsLab/PFF, subject to access, original provider terms and independently validated full H/A/D reference semantics
reserve.policy_change: Keep legacy match/country split untouched. This prospective v1.0 supersedes its v3 comparator, HGB-only intended candidate and .005 promotion gates BEFORE gated data/final scores. New comparator is v4, minimum mean gain .02; legacy v3 reported secondarily only. Do not rewrite original record.
rules: No final features, labels or scores in training, feature design, parser debugging or selection. Verify schema, label conversion and periods on train/dev first.

Freeze exactly one deployable candidate, code, hashes, weights, sensor scenarios and preflight checks before opening final data. Score it versus frozen v4 once; never choose a runner-up on final scores.
Final test is consumed upon opening, even after a failure. Any subsequent model change needs a newly declared untouched reserve; former final becomes development.
If full H/A/D reference coverage/semantics cannot be verified, do not silently switch to conditional H/A or fabricate D. Final full-task confirmation is unavailable.
All older external cohorts, including WCSF/Metrica3/European9, are research regression sets now, not fresh final confirmation.

final_gate.bootstrap: Report paired whole-game interval, marked descriptive due to shared national teams and only two groups; this is not proof of independent new-provider transfer.

needs: one unopened-source confirmation with no post-test model change
two clean source generations matching exact CSV bytes
official format validator on exact packaged file
source/data/model hashes and complete technical document
public repository at agreed release time and organizer receipt
release.if_reserve_unavailable: Keep verified v4. Prospective generalization confirmation remains PENDING; development progress alone cannot become a final-test PASS.
release.technical_vs_quality: A format/reproduction PASS says the algorithm runs consistently, not that its football predictions are correct.

interpretation: No absolute spellF1 threshold proves a model good across label providers. A good candidate is meaningfully better than frozen v4 on matched whole-game comparisons, robust by source/scenario, confirmed on an untouched reserve, and reproducible. Qualification and hidden organizer-match score remain unknown.
